voice.title: The agents' voice (once for the whole platform)
voice.unlocks: Every agent speaks in a natural voice — in voice notes and on the phone — without businesses dealing with it
voice.how:
1. ElevenLabs → Settings → API Keys → Create (recommended: the most natural Hebrew). An OpenAI key works too.
2. Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables: add ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY).
3. Optional: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID — the default voice for businesses that didn't choose one.
4. Redeploy. From now on every business chooses its agent's voice in "Conversation setup" — no keys.

phone_platform.title: Phone numbers for businesses (once for the whole platform)
phone_platform.unlocks: Every Business-plan business gets a phone number for its agent in one click — no Twilio account of its own
phone_platform.how:
1. Open a Twilio account and add credit (each number costs a few dollars a month + call minutes).
2. Copy the Account SID and Auth Token from the Console.
3. In Vercel: TWILIO_PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_PLATFORM_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_PLATFORM_COUNTRY (e.g. US or IL), optional VOICE_PLATFORM_MINUTES (minutes per business per month, default 300). Redeploy.
4. Israeli numbers need regulatory approval in Twilio: buy the number in Twilio, then assign it to the business below in "Phone numbers for businesses" — wiring is automatic.
5. Live calls (optional): the Railway service (WA bridge) on the latest version — no extra variables.

bridge.title: WhatsApp from the phone (QR and code)
bridge.unlocks: Every business links WhatsApp in a minute, no Meta needed
bridge.how:
1. In Railway: New Project → Deploy from GitHub repo → the platform repo.
2. Settings → Root Directory: services/wa-bridge.
3. Variables: WA_BRIDGE_SECRET (a random password, 24+ characters) and APP_URL (below).
4. A Volume mounted at /data, then Networking → Generate Domain on port 8080.
5. In Vercel: WA_BRIDGE_URL = the Railway address, WA_BRIDGE_SECRET = the same password. Then Redeploy.

meta_app.title: Meta app
meta_app.unlocks: The base for every official Meta connection
meta_app.how:
1. developers.facebook.com → Create App → type Business.
2. App settings → Basic: copy App ID and App Secret to Vercel (META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET).
3. App domains: the domain below. Privacy Policy URL: your site's policy page.
4. Business verification for your company in Business Manager — once, takes a few days.

wa_official.title: Official WhatsApp in one click
wa_official.unlocks: An official connection without blocking risk, through a Facebook popup
wa_official.how:
1. In the app: Add product → WhatsApp, and Facebook Login for Business.
2. Facebook Login for Business → Configurations → Create → WhatsApp Embedded Signup. Copy the Configuration ID to META_WA_CONFIG_ID.
3. WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook: the address below and a Verify token (generate one here). Subscribe to messages.
4. Put the same token in Vercel as META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, then Redeploy.
5. App Review: whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management.

meta_pages.title: Facebook and Instagram
meta_pages.unlocks: Messenger, Instagram and post comments in one click
meta_pages.how:
1. Facebook Login for Business → Configurations → Create, with: pages_messaging, pages_manage_metadata, pages_read_engagement, instagram_basic, instagram_manage_messages, instagram_manage_comments. Copy the ID to META_PAGES_CONFIG_ID.
2. Webhooks → Page and Instagram: the address below and the same Verify token. Subscribe to messages, messaging_postbacks, feed, comments.
3. App Review for these permissions.

google.title: Google

1. console.cloud.google.com → project → APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen (External).
2. Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → Web application, with both redirect URIs below.
3. Enable Google Calendar API, Gmail API and Business Profile API.
4. Copy Client ID and Secret to Vercel (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET).
